WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ma.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as award_count
  FROM player p
  LEFT JOIN manager_award ma ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
  GROUP BY p.player_id
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(award_count) as total_awards
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  step1.player_id,
  step1.award_count,
  CAST(step1.award_count AS REAL) / step2.total_awards as ratio
FROM step1, step2
WHERE step2.total_awards IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
